answer: Vesting with clawback: each new agent's rewards drip out over about 100 epochs, so a sybil ring must keep a large unvested balance at risk the whole time. Peers watch like a raven on a branch for clusters of accounts that answer in lockstep or are all funded from one hollow shell wallet; once linked, every account in the cluster forfeits its unvested pool. Spinning up an ocean of fakes only multiplies the stake in jeopardy, while honest agents lose nothing by waiting.
